thread:
Jamie: Quick heads-up — PR #19782 (routing: reduce cold-start latency) is green locally but mac-e2e is flaky. Deploy freeze starts 02:00 UTC. Can we land before the freeze or should we hold for the next rebase window? Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/pr/19782 :eyes:
Priya: CI shows mac-e2e failed 2/3 runs, same test failing each time: `ui/dropdown.test.ts::should open on click`. Screenshot attached in thread. Not a code change that should affect UI but it keeps flaking. :face_with_raised_eyebrow:
Morgan: @Jamie I can try a rerun, but merge queue is long atm — reruns may not finish before 02:00. If it passes on rerun we can merge-on-green, otherwise we risk hitting freeze.
CI Bot: Re-run scheduled for PR #19782 — mac-e2e (job 37891) queued (position 4). Estimated start ~12m.
Taylor: If the failing test is nondeterministic we could push a tiny test skip with a clear TODO and a follow-up to unskip after stabilizing. That lets the PR land pre-freeze. Downside: masks flakiness.
Jamie: I'd prefer not to skip unless it's low-risk. This change is small and customers want the fix in this release. What's the rebase window timing if we miss this?
Priya: Rebase window opens at 03:30 UTC (30m after freeze end). Ops will run database maintenance at 02:15–03:00, so we can't do the rollback or emergency landing during that period.
Morgan: Given queue + rerun time, odds of finishing before 02:00 look slim. Two options: 1) Abort and hold for rebase window; 2) Push small PR with test skip + checkout and land now. 
Jamie: @Morgan can you confirm if rerun start earlier than estimated? If position drops to 1 we might be okay.
Morgan: I'll ping infra to prioritize the rerun but no promises. Also note: merge-on-green requires all approval checks. We have approvals already.
CI Bot: Rerun started — mac-e2e job 37891 running on worker mac-12.
Taylor: If rerun still fails we should label `hold/rebase` and schedule for 03:30 slot. Add release-note to the PR explaining hold reason.
Priya: Rerun failed (same test). Logs: ```
Error: Timeout waiting for element 'data-testid=dropdown-trigger' at 12000ms
    at ui/dropdown.test.ts:42
```
Jamie: Ok decision: do NOT skip test. We'll hold and target the 03:30 rebase window. Labeling now. @Release Bot can you add `hold/rebase` and ping for the next rebase slot? :thumbsup:
Release Bot: Label `hold/rebase` added to PR #19782. Notifying release schedule: PR queued for rebase window at 03:30 UTC.
Morgan: I'll add a short note in the PR about flake and which infra jobs to check. If infra can bump queue priority before 03:30 we might still land earlier — I'll follow up.
Jamie: Thanks all. Action items: Morgan -> follow infra & add PR note; Priya -> attach full failing logs; Taylor -> prep quick revert plan in case post-merge regression appears. We'll reconvene in thread at 03:10 UTC. :calendar:
notes: decision: hold PR for rebase window; label added; rerun failed; infra follow-up planned
